calls.reason: This is a forecast with no deadline. The only evidence is a 2024 Register report on the gap between capex and AI revenue. That is the starting point, not an outcome, and there is no AGI demonstration, payback disclosure or write-down.

In July 2025, IMO coordinators officially graded Gemini at gold level, beating the 2024 silver from specialized systems. METR measured task length doubling about every 7 months. Both show clear capability gains.

The adoption evidence conflicts. Census shows about 5-8% of firms using AI, while McKinsey (65%) and Microsoft (about 70% of the Fortune 500) report broad use. Inference cost estimates near revenue hint at losses but don't establish them.
OpenAI expected a roughly $5B loss on $3.7B revenue in 2024. Anthropic's prospectus shows an $8B loss on $386M revenue. Midjourney is the kind of exception 'almost every' allows.
'Killer app' is an undefined value judgment. The packet only supports the side point that OpenAI lost about $5B in 2024 and has nothing showing whether other products qualify.
